plotEn: Imaginal Disk (sometimes marketed as Magdalena Bay’s Imaginal Disk) is a 2026 American experimental science fiction romantic musical film directed by Amanda Kramer. Starring Mica Tenenbaum and Matthew Lewin, who additionally conceptualized and edited the film and provided its music as Magdalena Bay, the film is a visual companion to their 2024 album of the same name. The film premiered at the Tribeca Festival on June 4, 2026 and will release on DVD on January 27, 2027.
